tools.name: tollbooth_pricing_quote
tools.description: Compute clearinghouse fee and developer net payout across Free BYO x402 (0%), Hybrid (7%), and Tollbooth Pro/Agency (3%) tiers in integer USD microdollars.

tools.name: tollbooth_wallet_balance
tools.description: Inspect an agent wallet credit balance, status, and remaining UTC daily spend cap. Read-only. Needs the wallet key for that wallet (Authorization: Bearer rcs_wk_...).

tools.name: tollbooth_issue_receipt
tools.description: Issue a short-lived Rail B rcs_receipt bearer token (Ed25519-signed, verifiable with /.well-known/tollbooth-jwks.json) that spends from an existing prepaid wallet balance. Needs the wallet key for that wallet. Does not move bank or crypto funds.

tools.name: tollbooth_verify_x402
tools.description: Verify an x402 V2 exact payment: EIP-712 TransferWithAuthorization signature recovered against the payer, USDC asset and network, recipient, amount, expiry and replay records. Read-only; does not execute on-chain transfers.

tools.name: tollbooth_create_topup_checkout
tools.description: Return a Stripe Checkout or sandbox link URL that a user can open in a browser to fund a wallet ($1+) or purchase a Pro ($39) / Agency ($79) Pass. Never charges automatically.

tools.name: tollbooth_register_wallet
tools.description: Create an empty prepaid Fiat Agent Wallet and return its wallet ID and wallet key (shown once). Moves no money; fund it later with tollbooth_create_topup_checkout.

tools.name: tollbooth_ledger_history
tools.description: List recent ledger entries (top-ups, charges, settlements) for a wallet or a developer account, newest first. Read-only. Needs that account's wallet or developer key.

tools.name: tollbooth_pass_status
tools.description: Show a developer account's tier (hybrid, pro or agency), its Fiat Agent Wallet fee rate and whether upto metering is on. Read-only. Needs the developer key.
